colors.source: semantic CSS custom properties scoped by ThemeV3

must: Search the public design-system API before creating UI
Create reusable UI in the library before consuming it in an application
Use ThemeV3 semantic tokens and public components
Include accessible keyboard behavior, responsive states, catalog specimen and tests
Keep applications connected to the package instead of copying source
avoid: Hardcoded product colors, fonts, spacing, radii, shadows or motion
Decorative gradients, glow, glass effects or resting shadows

decisions.decision: The Content Ventures design system is the single source of truth for reusable visual UI across all products and coding agents.
decisions.reason: Components, tokens and CSS must evolve once and remain consistent in every consuming application.

decisions.decision: The repository combines the reusable library with its visual catalog and verification harness.
decisions.reason: A component is validated in isolation before product pages consume it.

decisions.decision: The catalog navigates directly through component families and search, without inventory or review-tracking workflows.
decisions.reason: The harness documents and demonstrates the library; approval tracking belongs outside the design-system interface.
